### C388 RAG-003 CSV rejection reason conformity correction

2026-11-01. Actual published Project Chat modal rejected malformed CSV and disabled execution, but displayed only generic parse failure. Root cause: processUploadFile reads Error.message (`ui_validation_failed`) before the existing typed UiValidationError.key. Existing RAG-003 and CSV contract require a visible reason for malformed CSV/missing question/no valid question, with confirmation disabled and no new run. Under the approved CHG-388 conformity scope, handle the existing typed UiValidationError through t(error.key) before retaining the original other-error path. No parser/schema/API/permissions or new strings change; zh/en keys already exist.

Preserve the original failed receipt. Gate-policy eight checks and approved/published view continuation passed and do not replay. Normally seal the current Next source/counters, create a fresh source phase within the same tool container/deadline, then resume only CSV-local-rejection (three local bad files, no confirm/send/model). Run focused lint/type verification for the three changed application files; full coverage denominator remains148. Original8443 remains unchanged.

### C388 PIPE-012 governance waiting conformity correction

2026-11-01. Approved CHG-388 already permits root-cause-backed corrections within the existing specification. Actual normal copy, eleven completed extraction steps, formal distinct manager/Owner approvals produce version `approved`, pipeline `waiting_action`, step `publish`. The page currently tests only pipeline.status and hides even read-only evidence. The original failed Browser receipt and immutable SQL observation are retained. No new workflow behavior is proposed.

PIPE-012 completion gating applies only before extraction readiness. Governance waiting may show full read-only evidence only when pipeline/status and version match manager_review/pending_manager_review, owner_review/pending_owner_review, or publish/approved and all eleven automatic extraction step records are completed. Reliable-text OCR skip is represented by a completed OCR step with skip artifact, as the existing producer does. Unknown stage, mismatched version, missing/incomplete/failed extraction step remains blocked. Backend authorization, edit capability, content_edit_mode and review/publish locks remain authoritative and unchanged.

Implement in existing knowledgeReadiness.ts and import from the Knowledge Detail page; keep the current 148-file application denominator. Verify two actual GET payloads (published and genuine approved) plus six negative pure-classifier inputs; negatives are explicitly policy inputs, never successful workflow or fake-service evidence. Resume only the failed approved-view UI and CSV-local-rejection scenario. CSV failure was a test route mismatch: document history is intentionally read-only; use the actual published Project Chat modal. Reuse the two passed UI scenarios. Preserve old source/Browser/Node counters; close old Next phase normally before a fresh source phase in the same tool container and unchanged 23:34 lease. APP key 輪替工具設計（實作前）：依已核准 §C14／PREPUB-006 補具體離線兩代 key／全欄位預檢／單一交易／原子失敗與反向回復，見 docs/CHG-370-APP-KEY-ROTATION-DESIGN.md。未過期 replay、不可恢復的 feedback AAD／identity、未知加密欄位、AUTH 借用 APP 均零寫入阻擋。回饋新寫入改以 event UUID 綁 AAD，保留可證明的 legacy 相容讀取；API／DDL 不變。cursor／rate 維護影響及原 consumer 安裝仍需具體最後核准；這不是原秘密讀取或原操作核准。

收據觀察修正（實作前）：目前同步歷史 API 沒有 configuration_revision 欄位；首次 helper 誤讀造成 KeyError，相關27案中25通過、2個讀收據案失敗。保留原API契約，以真 API 返回 ID／status／source 與同一 owned SQL row 的 revision 對照，不新增回應欄位或重送同步；只補兩個受影響案。

同步收據接線（執行前）：模式切換與每日時間驗證已使 active revision 更新，初始 private context 的 sync_run_id 仍指第一版。以同一 owned DB 的最新 active-revision 真實 run 讀回建立僅含 run UUID／sync UUID／revision 的私有參照；若最新該版失敗即阻擋，不挑較舊成功、不重送同步。helper 仍經實際 HTTPS API 檢查該 ID、revision 與 succeeded；不新增或複製密碼。

Reports／session draft 接線（執行前）：共享 API 案例的空 reauth 仍期待舊 IdP session_required；現行契約2必須明確要求目錄憑證（422 credentials_required），設定寫入以 candidate UUID／revision 驗 locked（423），不依賴 KEYCLOAK／OIDC env。只加 current 分支，保留原 legacy 分支；報表權限、CSV、pagination、真正加密草稿 restore/discard 與 retired routes 404 的所有原意圖保持。

Lifecycle 契約補記（修正前）：35案中33通過；release readiness 說明遺漏角色名稱重用後禁止 code-only rollback 的既有必要限制，恢復與 deploy/README.md 一致的 V030／V031 回復要求，不執行備份或部署。另一案把 JSON Schema 明確 `KEYCLOAK_LDAP_GROUP_PATH: false` 的拒絕規則誤判為暴露舊設定；改驗其結構值必為 false，其他檔仍不得提供舊欄位。只補驗兩個受影響 case，產品行為不變。

Policy domain helper 首次真 SQL 批次的20案均在授權前因未提供 principal.user_id 而拒絕（user_not_synchronized）；舊 helper 只提供 Keycloak subject。依現行 PROTAUTH context 契約，直接 domain input 明確綁剛寫入專用 DB 的 user UUID；不把 subject 轉成登入捷徑、不改產品 resolver。20案同一前置根因，補驗僅限此模組；原失敗保留。

測試接線補記（實作前）：CLI／release 控制批次的兩個失敗分別是仍期待內建 Keycloak issuer、以及隔離來源缺根 `.dockerignore`。依既有 PROTAUTH-011 改驗生成設定沒有內建 IdP／OIDC endpoint、profiles 不含 Keycloak；原自訂 origin／port／generation 冪等保護保持。Migration build context 的精確允許清單納入目前 Compose secret entrypoint，仍逐項相等、不放寬萬用來源。只修公開測試前提與舊斷言，產品／部署行為不變；只補驗這兩案。

實作前根因補充：48模組批次發現recovery先解析空scope才處理null憑證，回泛用錯誤；共用maintenance_principal亦在憑證值格式檢查前查DB。依PREPUB-001補共用純輸入預檢，policy／recovery在DB前拒絕空值／雙憑證；真登入、契約與授權不變。另兩個失敗為缺少安全OIDC範例及Helm預設bootstrapConfiguration已刻意為空的舊斷言，只修測試輸入。

## CHG-364 — 移除 Keycloak 後的最小實機部署驗證計畫

本輪已收尾：Compose啟動、LDAP／Dex OIDC同人登入、正式Worker使用者／群組同步PASS；Helm兩次安裝均FAIL，依唯一重試上限停止，登入與應用同步NOT_RUN。Owned資源／私人輸入已清理，原21容器／13 Pod／3節點metadata保持。資源上限的完整證明有缺口：6 CPU builder與0.1 CPU短命輔助容器可能重疊，實際總峰值未量測；不能宣稱全部容量限制已符合。完整結果見docs/CHG-364-RESULT.md；AD及80%／前次安全事件保持未完成。

Helm首次安裝FAIL：Flyway初次連線後遇到postgres主機解析失敗，既有podDnsOverTcp不足以避免所有client的間歇DNS問題；bootstrap安全拒絕缺少migration target。已取消精確owned Helm客戶端，由Helm保留failed歷史。依本次允許的Pod網路配置修正，增加可選podHostAliases（預設空、IP與hostname清單），只渲染到已有Pod DNS設定入口；本次值只取owned Service ClusterIP，TLS仍使用原hostname及verify-full。不改應用／認證程式、映像或全域DNS。先記規格／計畫／測試映射，再新增欄位與單一真Helm渲染檢查；只允許同namespace／DB的一次實機安裝重試，原失敗與期限不重設。

Worker首次健康探針揭露同一配置隔離的另一個入口：Docker健康命令不經主程序的entrypoint，仍繼承host DIRECTORY_BIND_PASSWORD_FILE／OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE。於共用Backend environment明確清空非bootstrap所需兩欄，bootstrap原有容器Secret路徑覆寫保持；只重建受影響Backend／Worker／Beat及驗Worker探針一次，不改應用邏輯／映像。

2026-10-26 首次Compose真啟動：共用env_file把主機AUTH／DIRECTORY／OIDC *_FILE選擇器注入PG／migration，準備腳本跨profile處理而以invalid Secret file reference退出。修正僅讓profile消費自己實際使用的檔案變數；Backend未掛載的bootstrap專用目錄／OIDC secret變數清除，仍須嚴格驗證有掛載的required secret。不讀／複製主機路徑、不降低私有檔檢查。Neo4j owned測試TLS卷另改可寫以符合官方初始化chown，不改產品配置。原失敗收據保留，啟動只重試一次，無重建。

2026-10-26 執行前配置檢查發現：Compose API Backend自行列出volumes時漏掉認證CA與bootstrap掛載，Worker／Beat／bootstrap已有。依既有可信LDAP／OIDC及consumer配置契約補齊Backend唯讀掛載；不改認證程式、API、schema或TLS政策。先記本決策再修部署來源；只重跑受影響Compose模型檢查，後續真登入驗證consumer。屬Peter已核准最小計畫允許的直接配置修正，非新增功能或額外建置。

Fresh resource ownership decision（2026-10-03）：fresh無env/generation時，除了container，同project label的既有volume／network也必須先拒絕；沒有原generation與binding不能只靠project name重用孤立資料。拒絕發生在INITIALIZE之前，不產生新Secret或清理舊資源。已有完整配置的down/up仍可依其既有binding及validated model重用volumes。

Image preparation decision（2026-10-03）：既有配置選定的immutable／operatorimages優先，存在Dockerfiles不代表up可默默重build已選定的發布image。自動source build只適用本工具project-specific local tags，或已有source binding／explicit --build；digest-pinned references不能被build覆寫。Frontend／Backend缺少本機image時須在PULL階段先明確拉取，即使Compose有build欄位；拉取失敗在變更workloads前exit4，避免Compose late pull造成半途replacement。原CLI對unknown／duplicate資源仍拒絕，不新增automatic repair。

Implementation decision before privileged-port repair（2026-10-03）：macOS一般使用者native bind80/443回EACCES並不表示port已佔用；Docker Desktop仍可經其helper發布低埠。Native bind只在permission denied且port<1024時，以真lsof LISTEN inventory補查；觀察不到listener時允許Docker作最終bind判定，錯誤仍nonzero、保留foreign資源，不宣稱native已成功bind。其他bind錯誤仍拒絕。低埠fallback需已有lsof工具，CLI不提權或改system設定。

CHG-308 source configuration decision (2026-10-01): source commands explicitly load the uncommitted .env through uv run --env-file .env so SSL_CERT_FILE reaches real HTTP clients in the process environment. Source examples define migration contract and installation bootstrap settings, separate application/migration/admin credentials, generated initial credentials, and strict TLS CA/hostname verification for operator-provided live dependencies. Temporary source-test certificates cover cluster FQDNs and loopback tunnel endpoints; they are operator inputs outside package/release contents. No host DNS/trust settings or lockfiles are changed.


CHG-308 local DNS decision (2026-10-01): live Docker Desktop DNS UDP requests timed out while TCP queries to the same CoreDNS endpoints succeeded. Add opt-in localDevelopment.dnsOverTcp, restricted to the existing isolated development profile, rendering ndots=1 and use-vc for chart Pods. The Docker Desktop values enable this real TCP DNS path; production defaults and the shared cluster DNS remain unchanged. Verify actual service resolution, TLS discovery and readiness after Pod recreation.


CHG-308 CA mount decision (2026-10-01): Kubernetes projected Secret directory entries are symlinks, incompatible with the existing strict regular-file Neo4j CA guard. Mount each enabled CA file read-only using subPath, keep certificate/hostname and regular-file checks unchanged, and require workload recreation after CA rotation (subPath files do not auto-refresh). Validate the real mounted files, strict TLS bootstrap/readiness and Secret fingerprints; no application feature acceptance.


CHG-308 external TLS configuration decision: add optional external Keycloak CA Secret projection and Python/Node trust-file references for installation with private certificates. Operators supply a CA bundle containing all required trust roots. Frontend mounts the same read-only internal CA volume. Existing public-CA installations keep system trust by leaving the new reference empty. This is within the approved deployment/configuration repair scope; real HTTPS discovery and file mounting are verified, application login excluded.


CHG-308 Redis installation finding (2026-10-01): shared service/replication/Sentinel username represents one identity and must use one generated credential. Package manifests record the matching credential; bundled Helm runtime selects the same key used by Sentinel when usernames coincide. Distinct operator-configured usernames retain distinct keys. No authentication bypass or test double is introduced.


CHG-308 TLS finding: standalone Helm PostgreSQL certificates must cover the actual standalone service name and namespaced FQDN, and validate that identity while preserving verify-full. Regenerate only this disposable package TLS input; do not weaken verification.

CHG-308 installation finding: OpenSearch init runs as UID 1000 with a root-owned fsGroup writable emptyDir mount; cp -a fails preserving the mount root timestamps. Copy official plugins recursively without preserving ownership/timestamps, retaining all copy errors and existing hash verification. This changes only installation file staging. Static PV placement must choose an untainted schedulable node unless that workload explicitly tolerates the taint; no control-plane taint is removed.

SQLAlchemy flushed the old row's pointer before inserting its replacement. Preserve
the existing atomic revision/active-index contract by flushing old superseded state,
then inserting the replacement, then linking back, all in one unchanged transaction.
No DDL/constraint waiver or current-data repair. This approved CRUD bug correction
is recorded before implementation; regress actual create/edit/delete and lineage.
